Source.Title: 雇员同类物品存取
Source.Description: 打开雇员道具栏或陆行鸟鞍囊，右键物品即可在该容器与人物背包之间按类别批量存取。菜单显示类别和匹配格数。鞍囊合并普通栏与可用扩容栏。两个窗口同时打开时，可选择将物品存入雇员或鞍囊。

English.Title: Retainer Transfers by Item Type
English.Description: Open your retainer’s inventory or chocobo saddlebag and right-click an item to transfer its family to or from your inventory. The menu shows the family and the number of matching slots. Saddlebag transfers include all available standard and premium pages. With both windows open, you can choose either deposit destination.
